name: China Star Entertainment Limited
summary: China Star Entertainment Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the investment, production, distribution, and licensing of films and television drama series in Hong Kong, Macau, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. The company operates through three segments; Film Related Business Operations; Property Development and Investment Operations; and Multi-Media and Entertainment Business Operations. It also involved in the provision of other film related services, including artist management and agency services; and investment and development of properties.
